annotation.cut_point:
We are given two quadratic polynomials:

$$
Q_1(x) = x^2 + (k - 29)x - k
$$
$$
Q_2(x) = 2x^2 + (2k - 43)x + k
$$

$$
P(x) = Q_1(x) \cdot Q_2(x) \cdot \text{(some linear factor)}
